title: Evaluation of a parity block minterm
statement: Let $n,r,g$ be natural numbers, let $a$ assign a sign in $\{-1,1\}$ to each $j\in\{0,\ldots,r-1\}$, and let $x\in\{-1,1\}^n$. Form a conjunction of literals requiring $x_{gr+j}=a_j$ for each $j<r$ with $gr+j<n$; a literal evaluates to $-1$ when its required sign matches the input coordinate and to $1$ otherwise, and the conjunction evaluates to $-1$ exactly when every literal does. Then this conjunction evaluates to $-1$ if and only if the assignment $a$, replaced by $1$ at indices with $gr+j\ge n$, agrees at every index with the block of input signs $x_{gr+j}$, using $1$ whenever $gr+j\ge n$.
hypotheses_covered: $a$ is an assignment of signs to the $r$ block indices
$x$ is a sign vector of length $n$
